distribution: 云南大勐龙、橄榄坝、思茅。
en: This species is recorded from Damenglong, Ganlanba and Simao in Yunnan. The text preserved for the entry consists only of a figure caption naming the dorsal and lateral views of the head and a citation of the source of the figure; no morphological description of the soldier, alate or worker survives in the material available, so none is given here.
